tasks.title: Set up the marketing workspace
tasks.plain: Install the marketing agent and connect it to roomsie.
done: The agentic-marketing plugin is installed on both laptops
`/marketing doctor` shows no missing key, or lists each missing key with its owner
Both people can run `/task next`

tech.marketing: Install the plugin, run `/marketing setup`, put the keys in the local `.env`
tech.tech: Create the `marketing` branch, give GitHub access, create the Google service account, share keys through the password manager

tasks.title: Create the tracking sheets
tasks.plain: One KPI sheet, one spend log and one outreach sheet.
done: The KPI sheet, spend log and outreach sheet exist from the plugin templates
The service account can read all three and write to the outreach sheet
Both people and Yash can open all three

tasks.title: Write the roomsie voice guide
tasks.plain: How roomsie sounds in Hinglish, and what it never claims.
done: `docs/marketing/voice-guide.md` has tone, sample lines, words to use and words to avoid
It lists the claims we cannot make at launch: verified profiles, women-only, "thousands of users"
Yash approves it in its merge request

tasks.title: Canva template kit with Holkar
tasks.plain: Templates so daily posts look the same.
done: Templates exist for a Reel cover, a carousel, a Story, a poll and a countdown
They use the colours and fonts of the V3 prototype (D-01)
Holkar approves the kit

tasks.title: Set up Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp
tasks.plain: The three Meta accounts, ready to post.
done: Instagram professional account and Facebook page exist with the same handle
WhatsApp Business account and a WhatsApp Channel exist
Each bio links to the seeding form with a UTM tag

tasks.title: Build the seeding form
tasks.plain: A Google Form that collects people before the app opens.
done: Fields: name, Gmail, WhatsApp number, area, budget, room or flatmate, move date, where you heard of us
Niruv's consent text is at the top
The Gmail field is required, because the invite gate uses it
Responses go to a Google Sheet that the service account can read

tech.marketing: Build the form and the responses sheet

tasks.title: Seeding posts and messages ready
tasks.plain: Everything to send the moment the form opens.
done: Five post packs for Instagram and Facebook are approved
Message drafts exist for WhatsApp groups, Facebook flat groups, colleges, co-working spaces and companies
Each link has its own UTM tag

tasks.title: Form live and outreach starts
tasks.plain: Open the form and send the first wave.
done: The form is live
The first wave of posts and messages is out
The KPI sheet shows the first sign-ups

tasks.title: Seeding: Devashish's channels
tasks.plain: Own networks, Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp groups.
done: 250 sign-ups come from these channels (source column)
Each group post follows the group's rules
No post or detail of another person is copied

tasks.title: Seeding: Ritvij's channels
tasks.plain: Colleges, co-working spaces and companies.
done: 250 sign-ups come from these channels (source column)
Each contact is in the outreach sheet

tasks.title: Send the invite list to tech every day
tasks.plain: New Gmails go on the invite allowlist.
done: Each day, the new Gmail addresses go to tech in one `/ask-tech` issue
Tech confirms they are on the allowlist

tech.marketing: Export the new Gmails from the responses sheet each day
tech.tech: Add them to the invite-only allowlist (T-33)

tasks.title: Beta invites and profile help
tasks.plain: Get sign-ups to finish a profile.
done: Each invited person gets a WhatsApp message with the link and two lines of help
300 profiles exist on 11 October
Every person who gets stuck gets an answer the same day

tech.marketing: Send invites and help people finish profiles
tech.tech: Confirm profile creation works (T-16) and the invite gate is open for the allowlist

tasks.title: Article interviews
tasks.plain: Real people's questions become the article headings.
done: Three to five people are interviewed for each topic group with `/call`
Each transcript is checked by a person and is in `transcripts/`
Each interviewee agreed to the recording at the start

tasks.title: Article drafts 1, 2, 3, 7, 8
tasks.plain: Leave and licence, registration, stamp duty, police verification, society NOC.
done: Five drafts are made with `/article` from the transcripts
Each draft has a heavy human edit, a named author and one fact only a local knows
Each draft states its date for any rate or fee

tasks.title: Article drafts 4, 5, 6, 9, 10
tasks.plain: Deposits, deductions, notice periods, brokerage, deposit cost by area.
done: Five drafts are made with `/article` from the transcripts
Each draft has a heavy human edit, a named author and one fact only a local knows
Each draft states its date for any rate or fee

tasks.title: Keyword list
tasks.plain: One main keyword for each article and for the brand.
done: Each of the 10 articles has one main keyword and two to three related ones
The list is in `docs/marketing/keywords.md`

tasks.title: SEO pass on all 10 articles
tasks.plain: Titles, descriptions, headings and links.
done: Each article has a title under 60 characters and a description under 155
Headings are questions in the words people use
Each article links to two other articles and to the chat

tasks.title: Articles go live
tasks.plain: The 10 articles reach `roomsie.com/blog` and the Advisor.
done: One merge request into `main` holds the 10 article files
Yash approves it
The articles show on the blog and the Advisor can answer from them

tech.marketing: Open the merge request with the article files and their SEO fields
tech.tech: Yash approves; T-37 loads the files into the articles table and the blog

tasks.title: Search Console
tasks.plain: See how Google finds roomsie.
done: Ritvij has access to the Search Console property
The sitemap is submitted on launch day

tech.marketing: Request access; submit the sitemap; read the reports
tech.tech: Verify the domain through DNS and make the sitemap

tasks.title: Meta tags and schema on articles
tasks.plain: So search results show the right title and details.
done: Each article file has its title, description and Article schema fields
Google's Rich Results Test shows no error on two sample pages after launch

tech.marketing: Write the SEO fields in each article file
tech.tech: Render them into the page head and schema

tasks.title: Google Business Profile
tasks.plain: roomsie on Google Search and Maps.
done: The profile is submitted as a service-area business for Mumbai
Name, phone and website match the site footer exactly
Verification is started (it can take days)

tasks.title: Justdial and Sulekha listings
tasks.plain: Two local directories.
done: Both listings are live or submitted
Name, phone and website match the Google profile

tasks.title: Pre-launch posts
tasks.plain: A post every day and Stories, in Hinglish.
done: One feed post and two to three Stories go out each day
Each post comes from a post pack that a person approved
No team member's face appears

tasks.title: Find people for Reels and ads
tasks.plain: People outside the team who agree to appear.
done: The team decides who appears
Each person signs a short consent for their face in posts and ads

tasks.title: Launch posts
tasks.plain: Written before launch day.
done: Launch posts, the founder story and the list of groups and channels exist
They are scheduled in Meta Business Suite on 10 October

tasks.title: Launch visuals
tasks.plain: Images for the launch-day posts.
done: Post images and link preview images are ready

tech.marketing: Ask for them with `/ask-design` and add them to the launch post packs

tasks.title: Ad plan and budget split
tasks.plain: Where each rupee goes.
done: The plan splits ₹10,000–20,000: about ₹3,000 before launch to the form, the rest from launch day
Each ad set has a fixed amount
Yash or Niruv approved any spend over ₹2,000

tasks.title: Pre-launch seeding ads
tasks.plain: Small Mumbai ads that point to the form.
done: Ads run in Mumbai, ages 20–30, with UTM-tagged links
Each spend is in the spend log with the sign-ups it brought

tasks.title: Launch ads
tasks.plain: Most of the budget, from launch day.
done: Ads point to roomsie with UTM-tagged links
Weak ads stop within two days
Each spend is in the spend log

tasks.title: Weekly ads export
tasks.plain: Results back into the spend log.
done: Each Monday the Ads Manager export is in the spend log
Cost per sign-up is in the KPI sheet

tasks.title: Tracking and UTM list
tasks.plain: What marketing must be able to see.
done: A list of marketing questions and the event or field that answers each one
UTM rules: source, medium and campaign names
Tech confirms that the sign-up stores its UTM source

tech.marketing: Write the questions and the UTM rules
tech.tech: Implement GA4, Vercel Analytics and the roomsie events, and store the UTM source on sign-up

tasks.title: Meta Pixel decision
tasks.plain: Can ads see sign-ups?
done: Yash decides yes or no on the Meta Pixel
The decision is in `docs/marketing/decisions.md`

tech.marketing: Bring the question and the trade-off to Yash
tech.tech: Yash decides; if yes, tech installs it

tasks.title: Looker Studio dashboard
tasks.plain: One free dashboard for all the numbers.
done: It shows GA4, the Supabase events, the form responses, the spend log and the outreach sheet
Both marketing people can open and edit it
No raw rows are downloaded outside Looker Studio

tech.tech: Give GA4 access and a read-only Supabase login

tasks.title: Daily dashboard check
tasks.plain: Read the numbers every day.
done: Each day the numbers go into `/standup`
A drop of 30% or more gets a `/ask-tech` issue the same day

tasks.title: Partner target list
tasks.plain: Colleges, co-working spaces and companies.
done: 30 targets are in the outreach sheet with a contact person for each

tasks.title: Partner offer
tasks.plain: What partners get. Marketing decides.
done: The offer for colleges, co-working spaces and companies is written
It needs no money from the ad budget, or the approval rule applies

tasks.title: Partner outreach
tasks.plain: Ask partners to share the form.
done: All 30 targets are contacted
Each reply and next step is in the outreach sheet

tasks.title: Broker calls before launch
tasks.plain: Learn how brokers would list on roomsie.
done: Five broker calls are done with `/call`
The notes are in `docs/research/`

tasks.title: Broker calls after launch
tasks.plain: The remaining calls, split.
done: Five more calls each
The notes are in `docs/research/`

done: The launch posts go out
Each comment and DM gets a reply
Each bug report becomes a `/ask-tech` issue

New groups and partners each day

done: Each KPI is compared with its target
Each channel is marked keep, change or stop

done: Two articles a week go live

done: A creator list, a price range and a measurement plan exist

tasks.title: Referral plan for v1

done: A referral design goes to tech as a `/ask-tech` issue

tasks.title: Partner follow-ups and testimonials

done: Five real testimonials with consent
